title: Assign Cookies
approach: Sort and match smallest sufficient cookie
statement: Maximize the number of children satisfied by cookies, where each child has a greed factor and each cookie a size.
explanation: Sort both arrays and assign the smallest cookie that satisfies the least-greedy remaining child.

title: 132 Pattern
statement: Determine whether there are indices i<j<k such that nums[i] < nums[k] < nums[j].
explanation: Scan right to left, maintaining candidate '2' values and a best candidate for the middle value.

title: Circular Array Loop
statement: Determine whether a circular array contains a cycle of length greater than one whose moves all have the same direction.
explanation: Use slow and fast pointers while ensuring every step follows the same sign and does not form a one-element loop.

title: Repeated Substring Pattern
statement: Determine whether a nonempty string can be built by repeating one of its proper substrings.
explanation: If s is a repeated pattern, it appears inside (s+s) with the first and last characters removed.

title: Hamming Distance
statement: Return the number of bit positions where two integers differ.
explanation: XOR the integers; set bits in the result mark differing positions.

title: Minimum Moves to Equal Array Elements II
statement: Find the minimum total absolute increments or decrements needed to make all array elements equal.
explanation: The sum of absolute distances is minimized at a median; sort and sum distances to the middle value.

title: Island Perimeter
statement: Return the perimeter of a single island represented by a grid of land and water cells.
explanation: Each land cell contributes four edges, and each shared land-land edge removes two from the total.

title: Can I Win
statement: Determine whether the first player can force a win by choosing unused integers from 1 through maxChoosableInteger until the running total reaches desiredTotal.
explanation: Memoize states by the set of chosen numbers and explore winning moves.

title: Unique Substrings in Wraparound String
approach: Longest valid suffix per ending letter
statement: Count distinct nonempty substrings of p that appear in the infinite wraparound alphabet string ...zabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz....
explanation: Track the longest consecutive wraparound substring ending at each letter; their sum counts distinct substrings.

title: Validate IP Address
statement: Classify a string as IPv4, IPv6, or neither using the required component counts and character rules.
explanation: Split into components and validate decimal IPv4 segments or hexadecimal IPv6 groups under their length and syntax constraints.
